resources.title: Key Marketing Metrics
resources.content: CTR: Click-through rate (clicks/impressions). CPC: Cost per click. CPM: Cost per thousand impressions. CPA: Cost per acquisition. ROAS: Return on ad spend. LTV: Lifetime value. CAC: Customer acquisition cost.

resources.title: The 80/20 Content Rule
resources.content: 80% of content should provide value (educate, entertain, inspire). 20% can be promotional. Focus on solving problems, answering questions, and building relationships before selling.

resources.title: Buyer Journey Stages
resources.content: Awareness: Problem identification, educational content. Consideration: Solution research, comparison content. Decision: Vendor evaluation, case studies, demos. Retention: Onboarding, support, loyalty programs.

resources.title: Monthly Content Calendar Structure
resources.content:
WEEK 1:
• Monday: Educational blog post
• Tuesday: Instagram carousel (tips)
• Wednesday: LinkedIn thought leadership
• Thursday: Email newsletter
• Friday: User-generated content feature

WEEK 2:
• Monday: How-to video
• Tuesday: Twitter thread
• Wednesday: Case study publication
• Thursday: Instagram Stories Q&A
• Friday: Podcast episode

WEEK 3:
• Monday: Infographic share
• Tuesday: Customer testimonial
• Wednesday: Industry news commentary
• Thursday: Product feature highlight
• Friday: Behind-the-scenes content

WEEK 4:
• Monday: Monthly roundup
• Tuesday: Live event/webinar
• Wednesday: Partner content
• Thursday: Seasonal campaign
• Friday: Community celebration

resources.title: A/B Testing Framework
resources.content: 1. Form hypothesis. 2. Choose one variable. 3. Split audience 50/50. 4. Run for statistical significance (usually 2-4 weeks). 5. Measure primary metric. 6. Implement winner. 7. Document learnings.

resources.title: Typical Marketing Budget Allocation
resources.content: Content Marketing: 25-30%. Paid Advertising: 20-25%. Events/Conferences: 15-20%. Technology/Tools: 10-15%. PR/Influencers: 10-15%. Team/Training: 10-15%. Testing/Innovation: 5-10%.
